### Day 295: Acts 28:11–14
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-295-acts-28-1114.html
Passage: Acts 28:11-14
Points:
- God remained faithful to His promise by safely bringing Paul to Rome.
- Approaching a vast, intimidating metropolis filled with potential enemies was overwhelming.
- God provided encouragement at each stage of the journey through fellow believers.
- Christian brotherhood creates a profound bond of shared spiritual life and love.
- God meets our deep need for belonging through the fellowship of His church.
